survey.name: residence_type

choices.label: A person with a disability (physical, sensory, intellectual or psychosocial)
choices.label::hi: दिव्यांग व्यक्ति (शारीरिक, संवेदी, बौद्धिक या मनोसामाजिक)
choices.name: disability

choices.label: Migrant worker, seasonal or from another region
choices.label::hi: प्रवासी मज़दूर, मौसमी या किसी अन्य क्षेत्र से

choices.label: Internally displaced person, refugee, asylum seeker or stateless
choices.label::hi: आंतरिक रूप से विस्थापित व्यक्ति, शरणार्थी, शरण चाहने वाला या राज्यविहीन

choices.label: Enrolled in the national poverty or food-security programme (AAY or priority household ration card)

choices.label: A government health scheme (Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY or a state scheme)

choices.name: government_scheme

choices.label: Mutual health organisation or community-based insurance
choices.label::hi: म्युचुअल स्वास्थ्य संगठन या समुदाय-आधारित बीमा

choices.label: Privately purchased commercial insurance
choices.label::hi: निजी तौर पर खरीदा गया व्यावसायिक बीमा

survey.label: Was the deceased a widow or a woman heading the household alone?
